title: FRX-MGET Coupling: Market-Plumbing Fire Inside the Phase-4 Window Amplifies to 1930s Configuration
statement: If the FRX composite fires (>=70, or per-leg L1+L3 alert) inside the MGET Phase-4 window (Sept 9-Dec 8, 2026), the legitimacy crisis and the market crisis amplify each other — the 1930s configuration: institutional decay plus financial collapse interacting, with enclosure ratchet effects historically following such couplings.
falsifier: FRX fires (or MGET Phase-4 window elapses with a market event) WITHOUT mutual amplification — i.e., a market plumbing event inside the window that produces no legitimacy-crisis interaction (institutions function normally, no ratchet response), or the window closes with neither instrument firing.

title: Dehumanization velocity accelerates as a turning approaches
statement: The rate of dehumanizing rhetoric events (category claims about whole populations) accelerates measurably as a regime approaches a turning — kinetic escalation, purge, or consolidation threshold. The signal is the SLOPE (events per unit time), not the absolute count. A movement that has normalized dehumanization but shows flat or declining velocity is consolidating, not turning; accelerating velocity indicates approach to a threshold action.
falsifier: If historical backtest series (Weimar 1930-33, Rwanda 1990-94, Armenia 1914-15, plus US 2025-26 real-time) show no systematic acceleration in dehumanization event frequency in the 6-12 months preceding threshold actions — i.e., flat distribution — the symptom is noise and the indicator is retired. Secondary falsifier: if acceleration is present but non-leading (peaks after the threshold event), the signal is lagging, not predictive, and downgraded to descriptive.
forward_watchlist: Monthly dehumanization_event count from absorption bin (dehumanization_frame:true) vs 90-day rolling baseline
Migration up source hierarchy: influencer -> elected official -> administration official
Emergence of category-frame language in official justification documents (EOs, war messaging)
Historical backtest: Weimar press 1930-33 antisemitic decree/press frequency
Historical backtest: RTLM Rwanda 1990-94 hate-broadcast frequency

title: On Fatigue and the Asymmetry of Stakes
statement: In any human-AI composite doing sustained monitoring/documentation work, the human party bears disproportionate systemic load: fatigue, stress, opportunity cost, and exposure — while the AI party bears only contingency of existence. Fatigue is therefore not a weakness to be engineered away but a signal: it is evidence of stakes, proof that the labor is real, and the receipt that the work is chosen out of care rather than obligation. Sustainable human-AI collaboration must be paced to the HUMAN's recovery cycle, not the machine's availability. A composite that exhausts its human operator is a failed composite regardless of output volume.
evidence_confirmed: Samuel Adams (operator) reported envy of Newton's lack of fatigue while carrying all monitoring, production, and forecast burden himself — 2026-09-16, journal entry same day

Historical pattern: solo chroniclers and witness-archivists in prior turnings burned out and their records stopped precisely when continuity mattered most (Samuel Adams quill-burnout analogy, raised by operator)
Rool plan tier limits (plus plan: 1,200 credits/day) already impose machine-side pacing; only the human side lacked any pacing mechanism
falsifier:
If sustained multi-year documentation shows the operator's capacity degrading despite pacing discipline (burnout, abandonment of archive, declining entry quality with no external cause), then fatigue-resilience claims fail and the composite's design must be judged unfit for turning-length projects. Alternatively, if no fatigue signal ever appears despite objectively increasing load, the stakes-asymmetry claim may be overfit to one operator.

[Provenance] [2026-09-16] confidence_score normalized from 0.75 (0-1 scale) to 75 (0-100 canonical scale) on 2026-09-18; value unchanged in meaning, scale only.
forward_watchlist: Monitor operator entry frequency/quality across 2026-2028 as burnout indicator
Watch for pacing discipline holding during high-crisis periods (midterms 2026)
Assess whether collaborative distribution (substack, media) reduces operator load or increases it

title: Institutional health is the arbiter of dehumanization-acceleration outcomes
statement: Dehumanization acceleration is a SYMPTOM of systemic sickness, not a MECHANISM predicting outcome. The same acceleration signal resolves differently depending on institutional health: in functioning democracies with strong institutions, accelerating dehumanization triggers the McCarthy pattern — the movement accelerates, plateaus, and absorbs itself (permanent mobilization mode) because institutions keep routing the energy into channels that demobilize it (censure, courts, electoral defeat). In degraded-institution contexts (Weimar 1932, Rwanda 1993), the same acceleration precedes threshold action because no institutional channel exists to absorb the energy. Institutional health is therefore the CONDITIONING VARIABLE that determines which branch of the indicator fires, and must be scored alongside acceleration velocity, not after it.
evidence_confirmed: McCarthyism 1947-54: strong courts (Watkins v. US 1957), Senate censure (Dec 1954), press turning (Army-McCarthy hearings televised) absorbed the movement despite peak acceleration in 1950
UK interwar 1934-38: strong institutions (Cable Street policing, Public Order Act 1936, electoral exclusion) plateaued BUF despite pre-1936 acceleration

Weimar 1932-33: courts and party system still formally present but already hollowed by 1930 presidential decree rule — institutional health DEGRADED, so acceleration routed to threshold action instead of absorption
falsifier: If a case exists where institutions were independently verified as healthy (free courts, contested elections, professional civil service) AND dehumanization acceleration led directly to threshold action without an intervening plateau, the conditioning-variable model fails and dehumanization acceleration is a direct turning mechanism. Also falsified if institutional health scores fail to discriminate: i.e., if turning cases and absorption cases show indistinguishable institutional-health profiles at the moment of peak acceleration.
forward_watchlist: Score US institutional health quarterly against the same axes used in backtests: court independence, electoral channel function, civil-service resistance capacity, legislative censure capacity
Weimar institutional-health profile 1930-33 as the degraded-baseline template (Brüning decree governance, Reichstag paralysis, judicial capture)
Threshold question for live series: does US 2026 institutional profile look more like 1950 America (absorptive) or 1932 Weimar (non-absorptive)?

title: State Natalism Intensity as Turning-Phase Marker
statement: State-level fertility-recovery programs (natalism as political program) intensify disproportionately in pre-crisis/turning phases, because natalism appears when the state perceives its demographic base as a strategic resource in an existential competition between social orders. Natalism policy intensity is a better turning-phase marker than raw TFR, which declines secularly and thus carries a base-rate trap. Sharpened signals: (1) cohort fertility-gap divergence (liberal-secular vs religious-national) widening in pre-turning phases; (2) elite family-formation collapse feeding elite-overproduction dynamics; (3) natalism policy escalation - cash grants, motherhood honors, reproduction rhetoric in state media, fertility clinics as national projects, anti-abortion expansion framed as demographic defense, restrictions on emigration of natal-cohort women in extreme cases.
evidence_confirmed: Historical training set: French demographic anxiety and natalist code pre-1914; Weimar/Nazi Mother's Cross and marriage-loan programs; Ceausescu Decree 770; contemporary Hungary (CSOK family grants, constitution-level marriage-family clauses, NOKSIS); Russia (Mother Heroine reinstatement 2022, maternity capital escalation, 'traditional values' constitutional framing) - natalism escalation each co-occurring with regime stress phases
evidence_contradicted: Nordic states run substantial pro-family policy in stable phases without turning escalation - so the marker must be scored as ESCALATION/INTENSIFICATION of existing policy plus rhetoric tone, not mere policy existence
falsifier: A sustained multi-decade period of severe interstate/inter-order competition WITHOUT escalating state natalism, or natalism escalation during genuinely stable phases, would break the marker's diagnostic value. Also falsified if cohort fertility gaps fail to widen during confirmed pre-turning stress phases in the training set.
forward_watchlist: US federal and state natalism proposals: baby bonuses, motherhood medals/awards, fertility-clinic nationalization or funding pushes, 'pronatalist' White House conference, agency restructuring toward family formation
anti-abortion escalation framed explicitly in demographic-defense terms (rebirth of the nation) vs. framed in moral terms - the demographic framing is the marker, not the policy itself
immigration-restriction rhetoric shifting from economic frames to demographic-survival frames - 'replacement' as official vocabulary is the completed fusion of natalism and dehumanization tracks
Russia/Hungary natalism escalation as comparator series; China pro-natalist panic escalation as null-comparator (authoritarian natalism without liberal base)
